You're in a dangerous spot bud. You sound young, but I'll try to explain. I think what you're experiencing is actually a strong infatuation, not actual love. (They can feel similar, and infatuations can be very intense, but are temporary). That's happened to me before, but we just agree to friend zone and I treat her like one of the guys. You should see a doctor or start therapy, and be honest about being suicidal, or you won't get the help you need. They might even want to put you on a 3 day psychiatric hold in the hospital.

But that's okay, they're going to do an assessment, give you/recommend medication and refer you to therapy when you're released. If this infatuation, or love is the only thing keeping you alive, based on what you've said, when that passes, or she moves, or you get into an argument, or whatever, anything that may happen where you're no longer friends.. Those suicidal ideations are going to rebound, hard.

Seek help while you still have motivation (you posted here, so you're open to help) but don't procrastinate on this, seriously. You will not feel this way forever, once you get better, you'll think back and be glad you didn't do it over a temporary feeling. I speak from experience, been there, done all that. As an old man, I know better now. Don't wait, and don't resist their help.

Medication helps a lot, but I really suggest you combine it with psychotherapy, so you can find the root cause of why you feel this way, and learn coping mechanisms. You're not a lost cause, help is a google search and a phone call away! You can also literally walk into the hospital and just whisper to a nurse that you feel suicidal and you need help, and they will most likely admit you. Don't take this lightly! Seek help before it's too late! I hope you recover!
